title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go, parity fixes, version bumps
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Multiple SDKs diverged in auth retry semantics and streaming ergonomics after incremental parity fixes. This PR unifies behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go so customers get consistent retry/on-auth-failure behavior, identical streaming APIs (async iterators / event streams), and a coordinated minor version bump. Changes are intentionally minimal per-repo but coordinated in a single PR to ensure feature parity and reduce churn in docs and release notes. - Standardizes auth retry logic: token refresh hooks now use a shared contract (RetryAuthHandler) implemented in each SDK. Retries are idempotent-safe and capped by default to 3 attempts with exponential backoff. - Streaming ergonomics: exposes a common async iterator pattern for Python/TS and a similar channel-based iterator for Go. Adds optional `on_message` callback hooks and clearer error propagation when streams are closed. - Parity fixes: fixes missing content-type header on TS streaming fallback, corrects nil-pointer race in Go stream reconnect, and aligns Python chunking behavior to match server side framing. - Version bumps: Python -> 1.137.2, TypeScript -> 1.137.2, Go -> v1.137.2. - Tests & CI: adds integration tests for auth retry behavior, streaming reconnection, and e2e smoke across SDKs. CI matrix updated to run streaming tests on linux/mac where supported. - Docs & changelog: consolidated SDK changelog entries and updated quickstart snippets for streaming. Checklist: [x] Implement shared retry contract and per-sdk adapters [x] Add streaming ergonomics (async iterator / channel) and callbacks [x] Fix parity bugs in TS/Go/Python streaming transport [x] Add unit + integration tests [x] Bump package versions and update changelogs [x] CI matrix updated Notes for reviewers: The retry handler is small and intentionally general; SDKs adapt it to language idioms (exceptions vs errors). See python: redwood-sdk-python/redwood/auth/retries.py, ts: redwood-sdk-typescript/src/auth/retries.ts, go: redwood-sdk-go/auth/retries.go. Streaming API keeps backward compatibility but introduces a recommended ergonomic wrapper (see examples/streaming_quickstart). No breaking changes expected for existing users; default retry counts are conservative. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-1342, ENG-1407, PM-88, SUP-3210. Merge plan: squash merge after final approvals and green CI. Release artifacts prepared for PyPI/npm/gomod upon merge.

review_comments: Priya Kapoor: Looks good overall — can you confirm that the retry backoff constants are configurable via client options?
Avery Chen (author): Yes — client options expose retry.max_attempts and retry.backoff_base. Defaults are unchanged unless user overrides.
Liam O'Connor: Minor nit — in TS iterator the returned value currently uses `any` for payload, please tighten the type to `StreamEvent`.
Avery Chen (author): Narrowed the type to StreamEvent and updated tests (see b3e9f71).
Jaspreet Singh: CI flaky on mac streaming test in last run, saw a timeout on reconnect. Can we add a longer timeout guard on mac?
Avery Chen (author): Increased mac timeout and added retry hook to the test harness. Rerun CI passed.
Maria Gonzales: Approve after addressing the documentation callout about backward compatibility (explicit example added).
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth retry contract and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; parity fixes and minor version bumps to 1.137.2. Improved streaming examples and added integration tests.
